subject: Applied Mathematics

internalBreakdown.component: Internal assessment: spreadsheet practicals and project

textbooks: No NCERT textbook is prescribed; content as per the CBSE document
notes: The document does not break down the 20 internal marks; suggested practicals use spreadsheets or GeoGebra, plus a project.

chapters.name: Binary Numbers
topics: Binary number system
Conversion between decimal and binary; applications
outcomes: Convert between decimal and binary
Understand binary in programming, coding and machine learning

chapters.name: Indices, Logarithm and Antilogarithm
topics: Indices and their properties
Common and natural logarithms; laws of logarithms
Logarithm and exponential as inverse operations
Finding logarithms and antilogarithms; applications
outcomes: Apply rules of indices
Use logarithms and antilogarithms to simplify calculations

chapters.name: Introduction to Bhartiya System of Numeration
topics: Bhartiya system of numeration
outcomes: Gain acquaintance with the traditional way of expressing numbers

chapters.name: Clocks
topics: Angular value of a minute
Angle between the hands at a given time
When the hands meet, are opposite or form an angle
outcomes: Calculate angular displacement of clock hands

chapters.name: Calendar
topics: Odd days in a month, year and century
Day of the week for a given date
outcomes: Find the day of the week for any date

chapters.name: Time and Work
topics: Relationship between work and time
Work done by individuals and groups
outcomes: Solve and graph time-work problems

chapters.name: Speed, Distance and Time
topics: Time taken and distance covered from given data
outcomes: Represent distance-time relationships graphically

chapters.name: Seating Arrangement
topics: Linear and circular seating plans from conditions
Locating a person's position
outcomes: Design seating plans by logical reasoning

chapters.name: Sets
topics: Sets; roster and set-builder form; types of sets; equal and equivalent sets
Subsets, power set, universal set; intervals as subsets of real numbers
Venn diagrams; operations on sets
outcomes: Represent sets in roster and set-builder form
Solve problems using Venn diagrams and set operations

chapters.name: Relations
topics: Ordered pairs; Cartesian product of two sets
Relation as a subset of a Cartesian product; domain and range
outcomes: Find Cartesian products and the domain and range of relations

chapters.name: Mathematical Logic
topics: Odd man out, syllogism, blood relations, coding-decoding
outcomes: Draw valid conclusions using syllogism
Solve blood relation and coding-decoding problems

chapters.name: Sequences and Series
topics: Sequence and series
Arithmetic mean of two numbers
Geometric progression: nth term, sum of n terms, sum to infinity; geometric mean
Relation between AM and GM; applications of AP and GP
outcomes: Apply AP and GP formulas to real problems
Analyse the AM-GM inequality

chapters.name: Functions and their Graphs
topics: Dependent and independent variables; definition of function
Domain, range and co-domain; types of functions
Graphical representation
outcomes: Represent functions graphically and apply them to business input-output models

chapters.name: Limits and Continuity
topics: Limit of a function; algebra of limits
Continuity at a point and over an interval
outcomes: Solve problems on the algebra of limits

chapters.name: Differentiation
topics: Instantaneous rate of change; derivative as slope of tangent
Derivatives of sum, difference, product and quotient
Chain rule
outcomes: Apply the rules of differentiation

chapters.name: Permutations and Combinations
topics: Factorial; fundamental principle of counting
Permutations
Combinations and their difference from permutations
outcomes: Model counting situations with permutations and combinations

chapters.name: Probability
topics: Random experiment and sample space
Events and their types
Probability in real situations
Conditional probability
outcomes: Solve problems on conditional probability

chapters.name: Measures of Dispersion
topics: Range, mean deviation, standard deviation and variance for grouped and ungrouped data
outcomes: Choose an appropriate measure of dispersion

chapters.name: Percentiles
topics: Percentile rank of scores in ungrouped data
outcomes: Calculate and interpret percentile ranks

chapters.name: Correlation
topics: Karl Pearson's coefficient for ungrouped data
Spearman's rank correlation for ungrouped data
outcomes: Interpret correlation coefficients

chapters.name: Regression
topics: Dependent and independent variables
Regression coefficients and equations; properties
outcomes: Distinguish correlation and regression; compute regression coefficients

chapters.name: Interest and Interest Rates
topics: Nominal, effective and real interest rates
Simple and compound interest applications
Effective rate of interest
outcomes: Compare financial products and investment schemes

chapters.name: Annuities
topics: Immediate annuity, annuity due, deferred annuity
Future and present value of ordinary annuity and annuity due (up to 3 periods)
outcomes: Apply annuity concepts to real situations

chapters.name: Taxes and Utility Bills
topics: Income tax and GST under the new tax guidelines
Utility bills: electricity, water, PNG
outcomes: Calculate income tax, GST and utility bills

chapters.name: Straight Lines
topics: Slope of a line
Forms of the equation of a line
outcomes: Model demand and supply curves with linear equations

chapters.name: Circles and Parabola
topics: Circle and parabola as loci
Standard, central, diameter and general forms of a circle
Parabola from focus and directrix
outcomes: Solve coordinate problems using circles and parabolas
